name: Aino Niemi
bio:
Aino's journey into motorsport began with a fascination for rebuilding engines alongside her grandfather in their remote Finnish workshop. This hands-on experience ignited a passion for precision and problem-solving, leading her to pursue a vocational degree in mechanical engineering. Although early in her career, Aino's meticulous approach to fabrication and her ability to quickly grasp complex concepts make her a valuable asset to any team. 

While Aino excels in technical tasks, she's also keen to learn more about the broader management aspects of a racing team. She believes that understanding the strategic goals helps her to contribute more effectively on the shop floor. Her innovative streak, though still developing, is evident in her resourcefulness and her willingness to experiment with new techniques to improve performance.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, naturally wavy, often tied back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Aino is of average height and build, with a focused expression and a practical demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a multi-tool, even when not working.
Prefers working in silence, using noise-canceling headphones even when there is no noise.
Has an encyclopedic knowledge of vintage rally car specifications.
